archetypes.name: risk-integration
archetypes.rationale: The step3_loop_persist_envelope signature change and new WARN= KV could affect other callers and downstream parsers that were not part of this diff.
archetypes.prompt_body: Check whether any other callers of `step3_loop_persist_envelope` exist in the codebase beyond `step3_loop_emit_envelope`, and confirm those callers remain compatible with the new optional `$5`/`$6` positional arguments. Assess whether the new `WARN=` KV emitted via `emit_kv` could collide with any existing downstream KV consumers in `design-step3-review.sh` or related orchestration scripts that parse the loop's FD 3 output. Verify that the `write_envelope_stub` / `run_envelope_stub` test helpers in `test-review-design-step3-loop.sh` faithfully mirror the production execution context: confirm they source the same files in the same order as the real `run-step3-review.sh` path, and identify any production env vars that would be set in a real run but are absent from the stub's `env ...` invocation. Cite specific file paths and line ranges for any issues found, and follow the output-format rules from your outer wrapper exactly.
